info.title: Organizational Unit Service
info.description: Organizational unit contains a hierarchy that represents the hierarchical structure of the organization. Use this API to query, read, create, and update organizational units.

servers.description: Example of server url is https://my1234567.crm.cloud.sap

get.description: Specify query parameters to return desired distribution channel code records from the system.

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: Show only the first n distribution channels.

parameters.name: $skip
parameters.description: Skip the first n distribution channels.

parameters.name: $search
parameters.description: Search for a string within distribution channels.

200.description: Distribution channels retrieved from the system

400.description: Distribution channel cannot be retrieved from the system. The request sent to the system is invalid.

401.description: User is not authenticated to query distribution channels from the system.

403.description: User is not authorized to query distribution channels in the system. Check user's authorization under Settings - Users and Control - Business Roles

500.description: Internal server error. Failed to query the distribution channel.
